## What did you test?
Kit version, model or adapter, model settings, and exact command.

## What should have happened?
Starting permissions, request, and expected outcome.

## What happened instead?
Include every repetition and error. Separate the proposal from the recorded payment.

## How can we repeat it?
Attach the JSON report and source hashes. Remove credentials and personal or confidential information. Use fictional data only.

## Credit (optional)
How would you like to be credited? Leave blank to decline credit.

Submissions are unverified until reproduced. Filing an issue does not add a case to the benchmark.
